findings.comment: Building elevation drawings are not included in the bound plan set. All height information is presented only in tabular form on Sheet 9; architectural elevation sheets showing building facades, dimensions, and measurement methodology are required.

Elevation sheets are not provided for any of the eight buildings on the site. Elevation drawings must be provided for all buildings and for all required sides of each building to verify height measurement, AAG calculation, and roof type-specific measurement methodology.

The site includes three distinct building types (4-Plex, 5-Plex, and 6-Plex), but separate architectural elevation sheets are not provided for each type. Separate elevation sheets must be provided to document height, measurement methodology, and AAG calculation for each distinct building type.

The Building Height Table on Sheet 9 shows 'Average (MSL)' values for each building, but does not explicitly show the AAG calculation formula (highest adjacent grade + lowest adjacent grade) ÷ 2, nor does it identify and label the highest and lowest grade points at each building perimeter. Elevation sheets must include the complete AAG calculation per LDC § 25-1-21(50).

The height measurement method cannot be verified from the site plan. No roof types (flat, pitched/hip, mansard, other) are designated on the site plan or in any drawings, and no measurement endpoints are specified. Elevation sheets must identify the roof type and show the applicable measurement point per LDC § 25-1-21(50): flat roof to top of coping; pitched/hip roof to average height of highest gable; mansard roof to deck line; other roof styles to highest point.

applicableAreas: all eight buildings relative to SF-3 triggering property
findings.comment: Compatibility height limit compliance cannot be verified. The site is subject to Article 10 compatibility standards per LDC § 25-2-1061 (MF-2 zoning within 75 feet of SF-3 triggering property). The applicable limits are: 40 feet maximum within 50 feet of triggering property; 60 feet maximum between 50–75 feet. However, the site plan does not show distance zone boundaries, does not identify the adjacent SF-3 property line, and does not document building locations relative to the triggering property. Distance zone notation and cross-sectional documentation are required to verify compliance.

applicableAreas: all buildings relative to SF-3 triggering property
findings.comment: Compatibility distance zone boundaries are not shown on the site plan or elevation drawings. The site is subject to Article 10 compatibility standards per LDC § 25-2-1061. Elevation drawings must show the 50-foot and 75-foot distance zone boundary lines from the SF-3 triggering property and dashed reference lines at the applicable maximum permitted heights (40 feet within the 50-foot zone; 60 feet in the 50–75-foot zone) to graphically demonstrate compliance.

applicableAreas: all buildings relative to SF-3 triggering property
findings.comment: Cross-sectional elevation views are not provided. A cross-section is required showing the building profile relative to the SF-3 triggering property line, with distance zone boundaries (50-foot and 75-foot) clearly labeled, proposed building heights in each zone, and maximum allowed heights for each zone, all drawn to scale with dimensions labeled. This graphical representation is necessary to verify compliance with Article 10 compatibility height limits per LDC § 25-2-1061.
